body:
Packaging fixes: cmocean>=4.0.3, install_requires reduced to the six imported
libraries, sdist without tests/; app requirement floors; app_test CI job and
publication gated on it. cyclophaser/ unchanged from 2.1.2. Merges develop at
0dcc57a, green in pipeline 428. Authorized by Danilo (AUTORIZAÇÃO 2).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

circle_yml.string:
version: 2
jobs:
  build_test:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install package from wheel
        command: pip install dist/*.whl
    - run:
        name: Install test dependencies
        command: pip install pytest pyyaml
    - run:
        name: Run tests against the installed wheel
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
        command: pytest --import-mode=append -m "not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
    - run:
        name: Run source-tree tests against the checkout
        command: python -m pytest -m source_tree --junitxml=test-reports/results-source-tree.xml
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
  app_test_floor:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install wheel and app test dependencies (floor)
        command: |
          if [ "floor" = "floor" ]; then
            STREAMLIT="streamlit==1.56.0"
          else
            STREAMLIT="streamlit"
          fi
          pip install dist/*.whl "$STREAMLIT" plotly pyyaml pytest
          mkdir -p artifacts
          pip freeze > artifacts/pip-freeze-floor.txt
          cat artifacts/pip-freeze-floor.txt
    - run:
        name: Run tests against the installed wheel, with the app
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS: '1'
        command: pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
    - run:
        name: Check that only the allowed tests skipped
        command: python .circleci/check_app_skips.py test-reports/results.xml
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
    - store_artifacts:
        path: artifacts
        when: always
  pypi_publish:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build and publish tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build "twine>=6.0"
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Check distribution
        command: twine check dist/*
    - run:
        name: Publish to PyPI
        command: twine upload --skip-existing dist/* --verbose
  app_test_newest:
    docker:
    - image: cimg/python:3.12.3
    resource_class: medium
    steps:
    - checkout
    - run:
        name: Install build tools
        command: pip install --upgrade pip build
    - run:
        name: Build sdist and wheel
        command: python -m build
    - run:
        name: Install wheel and app test dependencies (newest)
        command: |
          if [ "newest" = "floor" ]; then
            STREAMLIT="streamlit==1.56.0"
          else
            STREAMLIT="streamlit"
          fi
          pip install dist/*.whl "$STREAMLIT" plotly pyyaml pytest
          mkdir -p artifacts
          pip freeze > artifacts/pip-freeze-newest.txt
          cat artifacts/pip-freeze-newest.txt
    - run:
        name: Run tests against the installed wheel, with the app
        environment:
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_INSTALLED: '1'
          CYCLOPHASER_REQUIRE_APP_DEPS: '1'
        command: pytest --import-mode=append -m "not browser and not source_tree" --junitxml=test-reports/results.xml
    - run:
        name: Check that only the allowed tests skipped
        command: python .circleci/check_app_skips.py test-reports/results.xml
    - store_test_results:
        path: test-reports
        when: always
    - store_artifacts:
        path: artifacts
        when: always
workflows:
  build_test_publish:
    jobs:
    - build_test
    - app_test_floor: {}
    - app_test_newest: {}
    - pypi_publish:
        requires:
        - build_test
        - app_test_floor
        - app_test_newest
        upstream:
          build_test:
          - success
          app_test_floor:
          - success
          app_test_newest:
          - success
  version: 2

subject: Release 2.1.3
